title: Sheep holding a heart
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="55" r="22" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
  <circle cx="34" cy="48" r="14" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="48" r="14" fill="#f0f0f0"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="62" r="13" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="62" r="13" fill="#e8e8e8"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="38" r="12" fill="#f8f8f8"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="12" fill="#f8f8f8"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="34" r="11" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x="36" y="72" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#7a6a5a"/>
  <rect x="57" y="72" width="7" height="16" rx="3" fill="#7a6a5a"/>
  <rect x="36" y="84" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5a4a3a"/>
  <rect x="57" y="84" width="7" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5a4a3a"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="30" rx="14" ry="12" fill="#d4b896"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="26" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#e0c8a8"/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx="34" cy="24" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#d4b896" transform="rotate(-20 34 24)"/>
  <ellipse cx="66" cy="24" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#d4b896" transform="rotate(20 66 24)"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="28" r="3" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="28" r="3" fill="#2a2a4a"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="27" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="57" cy="27" r="1" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- nose/mouth -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="34" rx="3" ry="2" fill="#8a6a5a"/>
  <path d="M47 37 Q50 40 53 37" stroke="#8a6a5a" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- heart held at chest -->
  <path d="M50 60 L43 53 A4 4 0 0 1 50 49 A4 4 0 0 1 57 53 Z" fill="#ff4d6d" transform="translate(0,4) scale(1.3) translate(-14,-14)"/>
  <path d="M50 60 L43 53 A4 4 0 0 1 50 49 A4 4 0 0 1 57 53 Z" fill="#ff6b85" transform="translate(1,3) scale(1.1) translate(-14,-14)" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- hooves holding heart -->
  <circle cx="41" cy="61" r="4" fill="#7a6a5a"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="61" r="4" fill="#7a6a5a"/>
</svg>
